question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks in the given sentence.

Shelley is good at ______ and also has a new ______ of the Oxford dictionary launched last month.
solution:
The correct answer is "**addition; edition**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The first blank requires a noun that describes a skill or activity. **
 
• **Thus, the word "addition" fits this context**,
